# Brett Gifford

> Brett Gifford is a creative director, design engineer, and producer in the Greater Boston area. He is Brand & Creative Lead at Cloud Capital, where he built the brand as a working design system: one source that runs the marketing site, campaigns, and production, with AI running the system and the creative kept human.

Brett has worked in motion design, brand systems, and creative operations since 2008. He was Art Director, Video Production at Paddle (2022 to 2025), Sr. Creative Producer at ProfitWell (2020 to 2022, acquired by Paddle), and Creative Lead at Zaius (2018 to 2020, later acquired by Optimizely). He has taught motion graphics as an adjunct professor at Southern New Hampshire University.

His position on AI in creative work: he does not use AI to generate images or video. He uses it to run brand infrastructure, meaning design systems, production tooling, site sync, and auditing. In his words, "I make the creative. AI runs the system that keeps it ours."

His own definition of the role: the person who designs the system a brand runs on, and keeps it connected to every place the brand shows up.
